notes:
Enterprise customer (healthcare analytics) — originally onboarded to Hosted API in 2022. Heavy embedding and summarization usage across clinical ingest pipeline. Primary motivation for migration: predictable unit economics and data residency for PHI-adjacent models. Quiet, technically savvy procurement team.

Recent discussion highlights:
- Customer wants Dedicated for production summarization (strict latency SLO: p95 < 250ms for short summaries, burst to 3k qps for embeddings jobs).
- Interested in Redwood Optimize to reduce token spend; asked for model/quantization recommendations for Gen-3 family.
- Strong requirement: private control plane or VPC deployment + KMS with HSM-backed keys; 7-year audit log retention for compliance.
- “If we get the Dedicated pricing within target and the DPA is acceptable, we can consolidate all inference across Redwood and accelerate renewal to Apr.” — VP Eng (paraphrase).

POC results: latency improved 20-40% depending on model variant; cost-per-embedding reduced in Dedicated trial when enabling prefix cache and batching. SE Priya recommended two SKU sizes: standard (8xA10G equiv) for summarization frontends, and a high-throughput pool (16xA100 equiv) for nightly bulk embeddings.

- Legal: accept customer KMS redline and confirm data residency language for EU-only datasets (customer operates multi-region).
- Solutions: confirm recommended Optimize rule-set for embeddings caching and quantization profile used in POC.
